item.title: Conservatives Win Harborough By-Election
item.description: The Conservatives have won the Logan ward by-election in Market Harborough. David Page was elected with a majority of 103, taking the seat which had previously been held by an independent councillor. The Green Party came second, followed by the Liberal Democrats, Reform UK and Labour. The result means the Conservatives now hold 16 seats […]

item.title: Council Tax Cut Set To Be Considered By HDC
item.description: The leader of Harborough District Council has revealed plans that could see council tax cut by five per cent. The move would save the average Band D household just over £9 a year and is set to form part of the council’s wider budget proposals, which are expected to be considered in the New Year. […]

item.description: Plans have been approved for a new special educational needs and disabilities (SEND) school in Market Harborough.
